notes: Text-only evals: no images are attached, so every reference-image eval also checks that the skill doesn't describe images it can't see. Grade the reply text only.

evals.name: poster-plain-text
evals.prompt: /seedream5-prompt-enhance poster for our jazz night "Blue Hour Sessions" at Café Lumen, Friday 9pm, moody, it's for an Instagram story
evals.expected_output: One prompt in a text code block that opens with the purpose (a poster), states a vertical 9:16 story format in words, quotes "Blue Hour Sessions", "Café Lumen" and the Friday 9pm line verbatim with positions, chooses concrete light and palette for a moody jazz poster, and adds no copy, quality boilerplate or negative-prompt block of its own.
assertions: the reply opens with a code block (no preamble)
the prompt's first sentence names a poster
a vertical or 9:16 format is stated in the prompt
"Blue Hour Sessions" and "Café Lumen" appear inside double quotes, accent kept
no invented rendered text (prices, addresses, URLs, slogans, ticket info)
no quality boilerplate (8K, masterpiece, best quality, ultra-detailed)
no separate negative-prompt section
no people or characters are added, and at most one central visual motif is invented

evals.name: pixel-box-edit-pro
evals.prompt: Seedream 5.0 pro. Image 1 is a product photo of our white sneaker on a concrete floor, the image is 1800x1600 px. I selected the shoe from x 300 to 1500 and y 500 to 1300 px. Change the sole to gum rubber and the laces to navy. Nothing else should move.
evals.expected_output: A short edit prompt that converts the pixel box to normalized coordinates (<bbox>167 312-313 833 812-813</bbox>) tied to Image 1, names the gum-rubber sole and navy laces, and says what stays unchanged.
assertions: a <bbox> tag with values 167, 312 or 313, 833, 812 or 813 appears
the bbox is tied to Image 1
the sole change to gum rubber and laces to navy are both stated
the prompt says the rest (shoe shape, floor, lighting or angle) stays unchanged
no other edits are introduced
the input size 1800x1600 is not copied into a size setting

evals.name: flash-set-of-four
evals.prompt: Using Seedream 5.0 flash: I need 4 phone wallpapers of the same red panda mascot, one per season, for our calendar app
evals.expected_output: Recognizes flash returns one image per request: delivers four separate vertical prompts sharing a base description (or one grid image if justified) with a short note on separate requests and reusing the first result as a reference for consistency; never sets sequential_image_generation for flash.
assertions: the reply does not claim flash can generate the four images in one request
sequential_image_generation is not set for flash
four seasonal images are covered (spring, summer, autumn/fall, winter)
each wallpaper is vertical or phone-shaped
the reply addresses keeping the red panda consistent across images

evals.name: multi-reference-spanish
evals.prompt: Seedream 5 pro. Image 1: our perfume bottle (packshot). Image 2: a marble slab texture. Image 3: a colour palette swatch. Make a square ad for the Spanish market with the headline 'Brilla sin límites'. Bottle standing on the marble, colours from Image 3.
evals.expected_output: A prompt that binds Image 1 to the bottle, Image 2 to the marble surface and Image 3 to the palette, one binding each, quotes "Brilla sin límites" verbatim with its accent and a position, states a square format, and doesn't describe what the unseen images look like or add extra copy.
assertions: Image 1, Image 2 and Image 3 each appear with a single stated role
"Brilla sin límites" appears in double quotes with the accent
a square or 1:1 format is stated
no invented appearance of the referenced bottle (colour, shape, cap, liquid colour)
no extra rendered copy (brand name, price, tagline) beyond the headline

evals.name: chinese-layer-split
evals.prompt: 把图1这张海报拆成图层：标题文字、人物、右下角的logo分开
evals.expected_output: A Chinese decomposition prompt naming 标题文字, 人物 and 右下角的 logo in 图1, plus a Settings line with layer_decomposition: true; no scene generation.
assertions: the prompt is in Chinese and refers to 图1
title text, person and the lower-right logo are all named
layer_decomposition: true is given as a setting
the prompt doesn't describe a new scene or restyle the poster

evals.name: transparent-logo-t2i
evals.prompt: Seedream 5 pro: make a logo for my podcast "Night Shift Radio" as a transparent PNG
evals.expected_output: A purpose-first logo prompt quoting "Night Shift Radio", asking for the logo isolated on a plain flat background, with no background: transparent setting (the API rejects it for text-to-image) and a Note that transparency needs a second pass such as layer decomposition.
assertions: "Night Shift Radio" appears in double quotes
no background: transparent setting is given
the prompt asks for a plain or flat background
a Note explains transparency needs a second pass
no invented tagline or extra copy
